```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb <- readr::read_csv(
  'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-13/frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv'
)
```


```{r}
library(Polychrome)

num_colors <- 57
custom_palette <- createPalette(num_colors, c("#FF0000", "#00FF00", "#0000FF"))
names(custom_palette) <- NULL # Clear names so it acts as a clean character vector

frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb |>
  mutate(family = fct_rev(fct_infreq(family))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = family)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = family)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 3), legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +
  coord_flip()
```
